channel.title: Gambia - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Gambia, every source cited.

item.title: Gambia adds 21MW to grid, signs solar project
item.description: Energy minister apologises for recent power outages and announces upgrades to water infrastructure.

item.title: Barrow cites SIS transformation as security reform proof
item.description: President Adama Barrow stated the intelligence service's evolution demonstrates significant progress in security sector reforms.

item.title: Gambia election sees 25 aspirants seek nomination
item.description: The Independent Electoral Commission has opened the nomination window for 25 presidential hopefuls ahead of the December 5 poll.

item.title: Gambia coalition seeks halt to new fishing licences
item.description: A fisheries coalition warns overfishing threatens fish stocks and local livelihoods, urging a freeze on new industrial licences.
